messages:
Samir: incident-bot just fired multiple dcgm alerts in us-west-2 :rotating_light:
Oncall Bot: alert: `dcgm_ecc_spike` on gpu-pool-usw2 (3 cards), severity=warning, group=dcgm_exporter
Jess: seeing brief ECC and Xid bumps across a subset of older A100s in that pool. counts spike then drop within ~90s.
Priya: current promrule uses `increase(dcgm_ecc_errors_total[2m]) > 0` which is probably too sensitive for these microbursts.
Kai: agree. also `dcgm_exporter` scrapes per-card, so we get noisy parallel alerts for each card. louder than helpful.
Samir: capacity note — we're ~84% in usw2 gpu capacity. Draining nodes is doable but hurts queued jobs. prefer suppression not immediate drain unless Xid critical persists.
Jess: quick triage done: `ssh gpu-usw2-134` -> `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` shows transient single-bit corrections, `journalctl -u dcgm-exporter -n 200` shows exporter restarts line up with kernel probe messages.
Kai: capturing the exporter metrics for context: `dcgm_ecc_errors_total{card="gpu0"}` and `dcgm_xid_errors_total` — samples look like spikes for 30-120s.
Priya: proposal: coalesce alerts by node + sustained window and add a severity tier. e.g.
Priya: ```promql
# Pseudorules
# 1) noise filter: require a sustained increase across 5m aggregated by node
sum by(node) (increase(dcgm_ecc_errors_total[5m])) > 0
# 2) escalate only when sustained across 15m or XIDs present
sum by(node) (increase(dcgm_ecc_errors_total[15m])) > 5 or sum by(node) (increase(dcgm_xid_critical_total[15m])) > 0
```
Samir: also add a 1m for-window coalescing so multiple card alerts collapse to one: `for: 1m` on the alertmanager side or use recording rules.
Kai: we should exclude MIG-only devices (label `mig_profile`) from this rule or treat differently. MIGs often flip counters on live tenancy churn.
Jess: +1 to node aggregation and MIG label exemptions. Also add `unless on (node) (node_gpu_count == 1 && instance_type =~ "p4|g5")` — for single-card machines we might still want quicker action.
Priya: oncall playbook tweak: when this coalesced alert fires, run quick checks before drain: 
Priya: ```bash
# quick checks
ssh $NODE sudo systemctl status dcgm-exporter
sudo journalctl -u dcgm-exporter -n 100 | tail -n 50
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=ecc.errors.uncorrected.single_bit --format=csv
```
Samir: if `uncorrected` > 0 or `XID` persists > 10m, escalate to drain+RMA. Otherwise annotate and mute for 30m.
Kai: we should also tune Prometheus scraping to avoid aligning scrape windows across exporter restarts — jitter scrapes and add `max_over_time` recording rules to smooth. e.g. `record: node:dcgm_ecc_5m:max_over_time
expr: max_over_time(dcgm_ecc_errors_total[5m])`
Jess: Ops: I'll draft a PR for prom-rule changes (node-aggregate + MIG exemption + tiered severity). Will include tests using synthetic metric spikes so we don't regress.
Priya: runbook change: add `annotation: "do_not_drain_immediately - capacity_sensitive"` for the warning tier and link to synthetic dashboards.
Samir: pinging infra on capacity: @Kai can you confirm we have hot standby nodes in usw2 to allow 1-2 drains if needed?
Kai: we have 2 spare nodes but not enough for a big sweep. prefer suppression first, targeted drain second.
Jess: thanks — I'll post the PR link when ready. planning to use `for: 5m` on the warning alert and `for: 15m` on the critical alert.
Samir: love the plan. after PR lands we'll roll to canary in a single AZ, watch `dcgm` alert rate on Grafana. :eyes:
Priya: small note: update alertmanager silence templates to auto-annotate who silenced and why. stops accidental long-term silences.
Oncall Bot: note created: ticket INF-4332 "dcgm coalesce + windowing - usw2" assigned to Jess
Jess: ACK :thumbsup:"
